headline.en: Inspect expert predictions before testing a prefetch policy.
headline.zh: 测试预取策略前，先检查专家预测。

sub.en: xpref combines recent router logits and observed expert transitions to predict next-token expert IDs, evaluates those predictions on saved traces and can hint mapped checkpoint ranges to the OS.
sub.zh: xpref 结合最近路由 logits 与已观察专家转移，预测下一 token 的专家 ID，在保存轨迹上评估，并可向操作系统提示映射后的 checkpoint 字节区间。

title.zh: 比较下一 token 集合

body.en: Predictions are scored against the following token.
body.zh: 预测与后一 token 的集合评分。

body.en: Explicit ranges keep layout assumptions visible.
body.zh: 显式区间让布局假设可见。

body.en: JSON labels projected throughput alongside recall.
body.zh: JSON 将投影吞吐与召回并列标注。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Python 3.10+; the shown installation uses 3.12. The demo evaluates the complete 128-token synthetic trace and hints one page-aligned synthetic file range.
note.zh: 支持 Python 3.10+，此处安装使用 3.12。示例评估完整 128-token 合成轨迹，并提示一个页对齐的合成文件区间。

body.en: Python 3.10+; the shown installation uses 3.12. The demo evaluates the complete 128-token synthetic trace and hints one page-aligned synthetic file range.
body.zh: 支持 Python 3.10+，此处安装使用 3.12。示例评估完整 128-token 合成轨迹，并提示一个页对齐的合成文件区间。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/xpref.git
cd xpref
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.en: The bundled K3-labelled trace is synthetic, generated by scripts/gen_sample_trace.py. Its recall is not measured model accuracy, and 4/12 t/s are hardcoded projection assumptions rather than hardware measurements.
limitations.zh: 随仓带 K3 标签的轨迹由 scripts/gen_sample_trace.py 合成，其召回不代表实测模型准确率；4/12 t/s 是写入代码的投影假设，不是硬件实测。

limitations.en: MADV_WILLNEED is advisory; hinted byte counts do not establish disk reads, residency or throughput gain. Uniform layout is only a synthetic approximation; real weights need verified ranges.
limitations.zh: MADV_WILLNEED 只是建议；提示字节数不证明磁盘读取、驻留或吞吐提升。均匀布局只是合成近似，真实权重需核实字节区间。

limitations.en: The bundled engine patch is an illustrative reference requiring adaptation, not a validated drop-in llama.cpp integration. This demo does not attach a live model or move data into GPU memory.
limitations.zh: 随仓引擎 patch 是需要适配的示意参考，不是已验证的即用 llama.cpp 集成。示例不附加在线模型，也不向 GPU 内存搬运数据。

body.en: A prefetch experiment needs both a prediction and an exact mapping from an expert to weight bytes. Saved traces let you study recall before bringing the predictor into an engine and measuring actual I/O.
body.zh: 预取实验既需要预测，也需要专家到权重字节的准确映射。保存轨迹能先研究召回率，再接入引擎测量真实 I/O。

body.en: Trace or ring records supply per-layer logits and fired IDs. Predictor blends a softmax prior with decayed transition counts and chooses the active-set size. ExpertLayout maps IDs to ranges; Prefetcher uses mmap and MADV_WILLNEED. Evaluation compares each prediction with the next token’s actual set.
body.zh: 轨迹或 ring 记录提供逐层 logits 与已激活 ID。Predictor 混合 softmax 先验与衰减转移计数，选择与活跃集合等大的预测。ExpertLayout 将 ID 映射为区间，Prefetcher 使用 mmap 和 MADV_WILLNEED；评估将预测与下一 token 的真实集合比较。

body.en: Trace or ring records supply per-layer logits and fired IDs. Predictor blends a softmax prior with decayed transition counts and chooses the active-set size. ExpertLayout maps IDs to ranges; Prefetcher uses mmap and MADV_WILLNEED. Evaluation compares each prediction with the next token’s actual set.
body.zh: 轨迹或 ring 记录提供逐层 logits 与已激活 ID。Predictor 混合 softmax 先验与衰减转移计数，选择与活跃集合等大的预测。ExpertLayout 将 ID 映射为区间，Prefetcher 使用 mmap 和 MADV_WILLNEED；评估将预测与下一 token 的真实集合比较。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: eval accepts --ngram-n (3), --topk-weight (0.6) and --ngram-weight (0.4). attach requires --checkpoint and takes either --replay or --ring; a bare ring name resolves under the platform shared-memory/temp location. --layout is JSON {layer: {expert_id: [offset, length]}}. patch-path locates the reference patch for inspection. Measure engine throughput independently when evaluating a real integration.
body.zh: eval 支持 --ngram-n（3）、--topk-weight（0.6）、--ngram-weight（0.4）。attach 要求 --checkpoint，并选择 --replay 或 --ring；裸 ring 名在平台共享内存/临时目录解析。--layout 使用 JSON {layer: {expert_id: [offset, length]}}。patch-path 定位参考 patch 供检查；真实集成评估须独立测量引擎吞吐。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
xpref trace-info --trace samples/k3-q4-128tok.bin
xpref eval --trace samples/k3-q4-128tok.bin --json
xpref eval --trace samples/k3-q4-128tok.bin --topk-weight 1 --ngram-weight 0
# After adapting and validating your own engine ring and tensor layout:
xpref attach --ring /path/to/router.xring --checkpoint /path/to/weights.gguf --layout /path/to/layout.json --max-tokens 128
